source: 外研社版选择性必修第二册 Unit 6 同主题完形(城市狐狸/聪明浣熊/野外急救包/热浪危机/火星种植求生/会进化的蜥蜴)。用词限 U6/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读/听力关不撞。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: An Urban Fox
passages.text: Late at night, a young fox slips into the streets of London to look for something to (1)____. Years ago, foxes lived only in the (2)____, but today many of them live right in the city. Far from their natural (3)____, such as larger animals that hunt them, these clever creatures feel safe. The fox soon learns that people leave plenty of food in the rubbish they (4)____ away. It can even open bins and other (5)____ to reach a meal. Some foxes have changed their habits and come out in (6)____, when there are fewer people about. The city is noisy and crowded, yet it gives the fox everything it needs to (7)____. Wherever new buildings go up, the fox quickly (8)____ to the change. It is no longer a (9)____ visitor from the woods but a true city animal. No matter how strange this seems, wild foxes have learned to (10)____ beside us.

questions.explanation: look for something to eat 找吃的。
foxes lived only in the countryside 乡间。
natural predators 天敌(后接 hunt them)。
rubbish they throw away 扔掉的垃圾。
open bins and other containers 容器。
come out in daylight 白天出来(fewer people)。
needs to survive 生存。
quickly adapts to the change 适应变化。
no longer a rare visitor 罕见的访客。
learned to live beside us 与我们为邻而居。

passages.title: Clever City Racoons
passages.text: Racoons that live in cities seem to be more (1)____ than their wild cousins. To find a meal, they must often (2)____ out tricky problems, such as how to open a rubbish bin. In the wild they would never (3)____ such containers, so they have had to learn fast. Scientists have (4)____ that urban racoons solve these puzzles more quickly than country ones. Like the fox, the racoon has changed its (5)____ to fit its new home. It comes out at night and searches the (6)____ that people throw away. There it can find all kinds of (7)____, from bread to meat. Life in the city is not always (8)____, because cars and dogs are real dangers. Yet, out of (9)____ from many natural predators, the racoon often does very well. No matter how hard the city makes life, these animals seem able to (10)____.

questions.explanation: more intelligent than their wild cousins 更聪明。
work out tricky problems 解决难题。
never see such containers in the wild 野外见不到。
Scientists have found that… 发现。
changed its habits 改变习性。
searches the rubbish people throw away 垃圾。
all kinds of food, from bread to meat 食物。
not always safe, because cars and dogs are dangers 安全。
out of reach from predators 够不到、远离天敌。
seem able to survive 生存。

passages.title: A Survival Kit
passages.text: Spending time in the wild can be wonderful, but it can also be (1)____. Whether you are a first-time (2)____ or an experienced camper, you should always plan ahead. Wherever you go, take a first-aid (3)____ with you, because it could one day save a (4)____. If a wildfire suddenly breaks out, leave the area quickly but stay (5)____. Never (6)____ up the group when people get lost; instead, stay together and wait for help to (7)____. Always carry enough water, since you cannot live long without it. Tell someone where you are (8)____ before you set off, so they know where to look for you. However hard the journey becomes, do not give up (9)____. No matter what happens, a calm and (10)____ mind is the most important survival tool of all.

questions.explanation: the wild can also be dangerous 危险。
a first-time hiker or camper 远足者。
a first-aid kit 急救包。
save a life 救命。
leave quickly but stay calm 冷静。
never split up the group 分散。
wait for help to arrive 等救援到来。
where you are going 你要去哪儿。
do not give up hope 别放弃希望。
a calm and optimistic mind 乐观的。

passages.title: When the Heat Comes
passages.text: Every summer, a (1)____ heat wave hits parts of southern Europe. When the temperature (2)____ above forty degrees, the heat can be deadly. The government quickly (3)____ warnings and advises people to stay (4)____ during the hottest hours. Many families fill the swimming pools and (5)____ to cool down. Doctors warn that older people are in the most (6)____, so neighbours are asked to check on them. A heat wave is only one of the many (7)____ that the world now faces. Scientists believe such events will happen more (8)____ as the planet grows warmer. To (9)____ with the danger, cities are planting more trees and opening cool public rooms. However serious the problem becomes, people who stay calm and help one another will (10)____ it best.

questions.explanation: a fierce heat wave 酷烈的(deadly)。
the temperature rises above forty 升高。
issues warnings 发出警告。
stay indoors during the hottest hours 室内。
pools and beaches to cool down 海滩。
in the most danger 最危险。
many crises the world faces 危机。
happen more often 更频繁。
cope with the danger 应对。
will handle it best 处理得最好。

passages.title: Farming on Mars
passages.text: It has been a week since the other astronauts left, and I am now (1)____ alone on Mars. A dust storm cut off our (2)____, and I was left behind. Luckily, the landing (3)____ protects me from the deadly radiation outside. My biggest worry at first was (4)____, but I have found an underground store of ice nearby. From the ice I can get the water I need and even (5)____ oxygen. Now my real problem is (6)____. There is only enough for about four (7)____, which is not long enough. Part of our mission was to grow plants in the Martian (8)____, so I have many kinds of seeds. I must work out how to (9)____ on Mars. No matter how hard it is, I refuse to give up. If I can solve this challenge, I will (10)____ until a rescue ship finally arrives.

questions.explanation: now left alone on Mars 被独自留下。
cut off our communication 切断通讯。
the landing capsule protects me 着陆舱。
biggest worry was water(后接 ice/water)。
get water and even produce oxygen 制造氧气。
my real problem is food(后接 seeds/farm)。
enough for about four months 四个月。
grow plants in the Martian soil 土壤。
how to farm on Mars 种地。
I will survive until rescue arrives 活下去。

passages.title: Lizards That Changed
passages.text: The green lizards of Florida once lived happily on the lower (1)____ and trunks of the trees. Then a tougher kind, the brown lizards, was (2)____ from Cuba. Suddenly there was not enough (3)____ for everyone, and the green lizards came under great (4)____. To stay away from their new (5)____, they moved higher up the trees. Up there, the branches were smoother and much harder to (6)____. Over a fairly short time of about fifteen (7)____, the green lizards began to change. They grew bigger pads on their (8)____ and stickier skin to help them hold on. In this way they could stay high and (9)____ from the brown lizards below. The story shows that, no matter how tough life becomes, living things can (10)____ to survive.

questions.explanation: lower branches and trunks 枝条。
was introduced from Cuba 被引入。
not enough food for everyone 食物。
came under great pressure 压力。
away from their new neighbours 邻居(指棕蜥蜴)。
smoother and harder to grip 抓握。
about fifteen years 年。
bigger pads on their toes 脚趾。
stay high and safe from the brown lizards 安全。
living things can adapt to survive 适应。
